command_line:
set -eu
Rscript - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79179037/inputs/dataset_566904a7-b378-4867-b4e1-1d0d9eb2eb6d.dat" "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79179037/inputs/dataset_a56640a5-a241-4f91-ba45-95d46142def8.dat" <<'EOF'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args) == 2)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(edgeR))
read_counts <- function(path) {
  d <- read.delim(path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = 1)
  stopifnot(ncol(d) == 1)
  d[[1]] <- as.numeric(d[[1]])
  d[!is.na(d[[1]]), , drop = FALSE]
}
ca <- read_counts(args[1])
cb_ <- read_counts(args[2])
common <- intersect(rownames(ca), rownames(cb_))
ca <- ca[common, , drop = FALSE]
cb_ <- cb_[common, , drop = FALSE]
counts <- cbind(sampleA = ca[[1]], sampleB = cb_[[1]])
rownames(counts) <- common
y <- DGEList(counts = counts, genes = data.frame(gene_id = common, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
y <- estimateCommonDisp(y)
et <- exactTest(y, pair = c("sampleB", "sampleA"))
tt <- topTags(et, n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH", sort.by = "PValue")$table
out <- data.frame(
  gene_id = tt$gene_id,
  sampleA_count = counts[tt$gene_id, "sampleA"],
  sampleB_count = counts[tt$gene_id, "sampleB"],
  logFC = tt$logFC,
  logCPM = tt$logCPM,
  PValue = tt$PValue,
  FDR = tt$FDR,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
write.table(out, file = "de_result.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

EOF
